capabilities: Automatically display today's daily note in the right sidebar at startup
Create today's note from the template if it does not exist
Replace the date field in the template's frontmatter with the current date
Override the daily notes folder, date format, and template file
Open today's note via ribbon icon or command palette without duplicating open tabs
extras: Desktop only, not available on mobile. Currently pending registration in the Obsidian Community Plugins directory and has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: Today Pane is built for Obsidian's core Daily Notes plugin.
motivation: The author built it to eliminate the manual steps of opening the daily note, dragging it to the right panel, and redoing this each day.
problem: Pinning a daily note to the right sidebar requires manual drag-and-drop that must be repeated every day because the pinned note's date is fixed.

relations.evidence: Today Pane is built for Obsidian's core Daily Notes plugin.
It does not natively support Periodic Notes or Journals, since those plugins use different settings

summary: Side panel that always displays today's daily note in the right sidebar, opening it automatically at startup and updating the date each day.
